newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Konka '96 net rises 30.55 pct.
newsitem.headline: Konka '96 net rises 30.55 pct.

text.p: (in millions of yuan unless stated, against 1995 figures)
Earnings per share 0.9466 yuan vs 0.9426 yuan
Net assets per share 3.97 yuan vs 2.75 yuan
Company name: Shenzhen Konka Group Co Ltd.
NOTE: The results were published in an annual report in the Shenzhen-based Securities Times on Friday.
The 1996 figures were based on both international and Chinese accounting standards while the 1995 results were based on Chinese accounting standards.
According to the 1995 annual report, the company posted net profits of 268 million yuan on turnover of 3.48 billion yuan under international standards.
Konka said its board of directors proposed a cash dividend of 0.52 yuan per share based on 1996 profits, pending approval of shareholders at a meeting on May 12.
Trading in its A and B shares will be suspended on Friday morning and will resume in the afternoon, the Shenzhen Stock Exchange has said.
